nodes.name: Scraping Config
nodes.notes: Configure which platform to scrape and credentials. Options: linkedin, google_maps, apollo, reddit, twitter, facebook, instagram

nodes.name: LinkedIn Puppeteer Scraper
nodes.notes: Scrapes LinkedIn search results using Puppeteer. Requires valid li_at session cookie.

nodes.name: Google Maps Puppeteer Scraper
nodes.notes: Scrapes local businesses from Google Maps. Customize search query in the code.

nodes.name: Apollo.io API
nodes.notes: Apollo.io API fallback. Free tier: 50 contacts/month. Get API key from apollo.io

parameters.url: =https://www.reddit.com/r/{{ $json.subreddit || 'Entrepreneur' }}/search.json?q={{ encodeURIComponent($json.search_query || 'need automation OR manual processes OR hiring VA') }}&sort=relevance&t=month&limit=50

nodes.name: Reddit JSON API
nodes.notes: Scrapes Reddit for pain points. No API key needed. Subreddits: Entrepreneur, smallbusiness, startups

nodes.name: Twitter API v2
nodes.notes: Twitter API free tier: 1500 tweets/month. Get bearer token from developer.twitter.com

nodes.name: Facebook Groups Scraper
nodes.notes: Facebook scraping is complex due to auth. Consider manual export or Facebook Graph API.

nodes.name: Instagram Business Scraper
nodes.notes: Instagram scraping is complex. Consider Instagram Graph API or Apify scrapers.

nodes.name: Merge All Sources
nodes.notes: Combines leads from all scraping sources

nodes.name: Clean & Deduplicate
nodes.notes: Removes duplicates by email, LinkedIn URL, or company+name combination

nodes.name: Append to Raw Leads
nodes.notes: Appends deduplicated leads to Google Sheets
